Military vs. civilian prioritisation effect (REHASIM)

Source: R/mil_civil.R
mil_civil_effect.Rd

Compares two REHASIM scenarios that differ only in mil/civil prioritisation and returns Return-to-Duty (RTD) rates, cost per RTD and the difference (delta) with bootstrap CIs.

Usage

mil_civil_effect(
  data,
  mil_scenario,
  civ_scenario,
  outcome_col = "rtd_rate",
  cost_col = "cost",
  alpha = 0.05,
  n_bootstrap = 1000
)

Arguments

data

A dynasimR_data object or summary tibble.

mil_scenario

Character. Scenario ID with military priority.

civ_scenario

Character. Scenario ID with civilian-inclusive priority.

outcome_col

Character. Column name for RTD outcome. Default "rtd_rate".

cost_col

Character. Column name for cost metric. Default "cost".

alpha

Numeric. Significance level. Default 0.05.

n_bootstrap

Integer. Bootstrap replicates. Default 1000.

Value

An S3 object of class dynasimR_mil_civil with slots rtd, cost, delta_rtd, delta_cost, params.
